TRADE COURT, CASE #5: T-ROSS AND A FIRST FOR IBAKA 🎮🏀 Was it worth it?

• Feb 14, 2017: we sent Terrence Ross and a first-round pick to Orlando for Serge Ibaka
• Ross was the 2013 dunk champ, and once scored 51 for us
• 2019: Ibaka won a ring with us

Ibaka or T-Ross? Who won the trade?

facts.claim: On 14 February 2017 (Feb 14, 2017, Valentine's Day), Ibaka was traded from the Orlando Magic to the Toronto Raptors for Terrence Ross and a future first-round draft pick (1 first). Ibaka won an NBA championship with Toronto in 2019, two years later. ESPN id Ibaka 3439.
Terrence Ross was the 2013 NBA Slam Dunk Contest champion and scored 51 points vs the Los Angeles Clippers on January 25, 2014. ESPN id Ross 6619.
